narr: Heavy rainfall associated with Tropical Storm Debby occurred across the CSRA for several days. The event peaked in this region on August 6th in Burke County where multiple reports of flooding were reported.
ev: Burke County Emergency Management reported Herndon Road was closed with water running over the roadway 2 miles North of Byne Sunshine Road.
GDOT and Burke County EM reported Highway 24 between Thompson Bridge Road and the Town of Alexander had to be closed due to flooding.
Burke County EM reported multiple flooded roadways in the Town of Sardis including North Mill Street, Cemetery Street, and along Old Sardis Road.
Burke County EM reported roadway flooded at the intersection of Drake Road and Highway 25 South.
Burke County EM reported Highway 23 at Black Road is flooded.
Burke County Sheriff's Office reported Mill Pond Road near Murray Hill Road is closed due to flooding.
